usage: Shared stage backgrounds for Spell Training, Practice Arena, and Solo Duel. PNG originals are preserved. Game JPEGs use quality 88; 400-pixel thumbnails use quality 82, converted with macOS sips.

images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: one standalone background for Wizard Combat, a mature cinematic wizard dueling game. Wide 16:9 landscape image, ideally 1920x1080. Polished realistic fantasy game environment, detailed materials, restrained painterly finish, physically convincing architecture, atmospheric depth, no cartoon treatment. Fixed camera for a side-view duel: broad level foreground floor spans the entire lower quarter; future fighter feet sit about 82% down the image, at 18% and 85% of its width. Both future fighter areas must stay unobstructed. Camera faces the scene across this horizontal fighting strip, natural perspective, no fisheye. Large architectural or landscape features sit behind the fighting plane. Clear space between future fighters for spell projectiles. Cool soft fill light keeps foreground readable, highlights controlled. No people, no creatures, no character silhouettes, no fighters, no text, no logos, no UI, no borders, no collage. Full-bleed single environment. Moonlit Courtyard: majestic ancient wizard castle courtyard at night, weathered slate paving with faint damp reflections, Gothic arcades at the sides, distant spires and mountains, blue moonlight, subtle teal mist, small warm braziers behind the fight area. Noble, mysterious and spacious. Keep the moon modest in size, central view open.

Regenerate this single game background as a believable Platform 9¾ inside a London railway terminus. The attached image is a COMPOSITION reference only: keep its wide 16:9 framing and broad empty horizontal foreground platform for two game fighters. Rebuild the setting completely. The previous castle backdrop and extravagant fantasy architecture were WRONG. There must be NO CASTLE, no spires, no mountains, no lake, no moonlit fantasy skyline anywhere. Setting: a convincing enclosed late-Victorian London station, weathered reddish-brown brick end walls, practical riveted iron roof trusses, a modest high barrel-vault roof with cloudy glass panes, ordinary station lamps. Track and platform geometry must be physically credible. A realistically proportioned scarlet British steam locomotive with black smokebox, proper large driving wheels and mechanical connecting rods, coal tender and maroon passenger coaches is parked along the track in the middle background, viewed from its side with a slight natural perspective. Authentic working railway machinery, not a decorative toy train. The broad foreground platform is on the camera side of the track, its edge behind the future fighters. Worn dry gray paving, a few darker patches, subtle soot and natural wear; no glossy flooded palace floor. Small amount of steam near locomotive wheels only. Cool overcast daylight through the glass roof, subtle warm station lamps, realistic exposure, detailed cinematic game environment matching the quality of the other wizard stages without fantasy architecture. Optional one small period hanging platform sign with the exact text '9¾' near the upper side; no other readable text. Keep the lower quarter entirely clear and level for a side-view fight, feet locations at 18% and 85% of width and 82% down the image. All columns and props behind the fighting strip or at the very outer edges. No people, fighters, animals, luggage on the fighting floor, magic effects, ornate gold trim, UI, border, watermark or collage. Produce just one full-bleed landscape stage background.

selectionPortraits.prompt: Create a production UI overlay asset from this approved selection-screen mockup. Extract ONLY the two wizard portraits in the upper scene, as one genuinely transparent PNG. Preserve their exact appearance, faces, hair, robes, wands, poses, lighting and relative positions: black-haired male in dark navy and gold on the extreme LEFT facing inward; woman in burgundy and gold on the extreme RIGHT facing inward. Preserve their natural original crop at the bottom of the hero scene, approximately waist. Output a wide canvas matching ONLY the upper cinematic preview portion, aspect ratio about 3.5:1. The male occupies the left 28% and female right 28%; center 44% is completely transparent. No scenery whatsoever, no castle, no sky, no text, no titles, no buttons, no frames, no tiles, no UI, no fake checkerboard, no shadows baked into an opaque background. The entire space around and between the two organic silhouettes is alpha transparent. No new characters. These two portraits must overlay arbitrary stage backgrounds. Keep tiny wand-tip glows localized with soft alpha. Output only this single wide transparent two-portrait overlay.
